rootCause: GENERATE_CAREER_POOL had a 12 second queue deadline although an identical non-thinking career response required 13.691 seconds.
The queue AbortSignal was not passed into the Provider request, so the UI operation could time out while the paid request continued in the background.
DeepSeek thinking was disabled only for world tasks, leaving strict career generation on provider-default reasoning.
The transaction commit occurred outside the intent-deduplicated queue, allowing concurrent callers to invoke commit more than once.
The transport used one absolute deadline for the entire response, so continuous response progress could still be interrupted.
